title: Easy xl Twin bed frame
text: Easy xl Twin bed frame. I purchased this frame because it seemed easy to set up and it was xl Twin.  It WAS easy to set up.... I am 57 and a girl....it took me about 15 minutes to set up.  It is true black and metal. The instructions were simple and easy to understand, with pictures.  It is solid and a good solid weight.  It does have a center bar with 2 feet.  I think this will add to the stability of the frame.  I purchased a memory foam xl twin mattress (also from Amazon) and it fit perfectly.  The mattress I purchased is 11" thick and so it rises above the footboard, but I am ok with that look.  I like that the foot and headboard are simple, plain design. It is nice that should we ever decide to do so, we could disassemble, fold up and store.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

description: Our easy set-up steel platform bifold bed is made with a sturdy metal structure and built-in slats, headboard and footboard. It's a unique modern design that reflects our contemporary lifestyles. Our patented folding mechanism makes this bed easy to assemble and disassemble for convenient portability and storage. It's a complete mattress support system with no box spring needed, perfect for all urban dwellers and frequent movers. Great for home use, dormitories and for temporary settings. For visiting family or friends, easily convert your spare room into a bedroom. Setup is a breeze in four simple steps! Simply unfold, tighten the 4 support bolts and screw in the headboard and footboard knobs.
